gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Byte 0x53 has upper nibble 0x50, which triggers the skippable-frame path, but subsequent bytes do not match SKIPPABLE_FRAME_MAGIC so matches() returns false.
ADDED i5: …signature[2] remains 0x00, which != SKIPPABLE_FRAME_MAGIC[1] (0x4D), so no match
ADDED i6: A one-element array with first byte 0x28 passes the length guard (length=40 >= 4), but the loop then reads signature[1] which is out of bounds.
ADDED i8: Negative length is smaller than ZSTANDARD_FRAME_MAGIC.length (4), so the method returns false immediately without examining the (null) signature array.
ADDED i9: All-zero bytes match neither Zstandard frame magic (0x28, 0xB5, 0x2F, 0xFD) nor the skippable-frame prefix (upper nibble 0x50), so matches() returns false.
ADDED i10: With caching disabled the method falls back to the internal class-loading check, which still finds the zstd-jni library on the test classpath.
